Name: Choose and register an inexpensive branded domain for one year
Completion criteria: Complete subtasks 01a–01e in brand-domain-automation.md: live availability and first-year/renewal comparison, owner-selected one-year checkout, and domain register with renewal reminders. Targets are planning budgets, not price or availability claims. Purchase only with explicit domain/cost authorization.

Name: Migrate from temporary elancabin.com and track retirement
Completion criteria: Configure the selected domain on existing free hosting, DNS/CNAME, HTTPS and apex/www; verify before changing links. Record old-domain redirect/renewal/retirement and rollback decisions in domain-register.csv. Keep elancabin.com live during transition.

Name: Complete the domain migration for SEO and integrations
Completion criteria: Update canonical URLs, sitemap, social previews, repository settings, and any Meta OAuth/privacy URLs actually in use; verify old links and search-console setup.

Name: Connect the Instagram profile to the website
Completion criteria: Set the permanent website in the profile link and a clear bio; upload the selected profile icon manually. Verify the link opens the correct site.

Name: Make website and Instagram navigation feel connected
Completion criteria: Audit the existing header link; add useful Instagram links to footer/about or listing context, and define a simple Instagram landing route. Avoid a heavy embedded feed. Verify each route.

Name: Deliver one coherent brand kit across website and Instagram
Completion criteria: Complete 06a–06h: positioning, editable logo master, icon/wordmark/favicon/preview exports, existing color/type rules, compact website pass, post templates, profile copy and cross-channel acceptance. Follow brand-domain-automation.md; preserve the selected direction and visual distinction.

Name: Simplify the website around finding cabins
Completion criteria: Review desktop header, cards, photo hierarchy, filters, and original-listing actions; make listings immediately accessible. No new hero, long introductory copy, or dedicated mobile redesign in this phase.

Name: Define one shared listing and content model
Completion criteria: Document stable property IDs, source facts, review dates, photo provenance, captions, slide selections, queue states, and published Instagram IDs/links. Decide which fields remain file-backed initially.

Name: Link published Instagram posts to website listings
Completion criteria: Join publication history to property IDs; show verified post links on relevant cards/detail views. Keep this to simple secondary links; no Instagram-only filter or promotional badges. No guessed links or browser-only API secrets.
Evidence/PR: docs/website-instagram.md; 104 tests, build/SEO and desktop checks passed; pending manual deployment

Name: Build a private operations dashboard
Completion criteria: Secure the operator view; show candidates, stale listings, ready posts, published posts, failures, and last successful jobs. Start read-only; add actions only as needed.

Name: Connect Supabase when the dashboard needs it
Completion criteria: Review the existing schema, migrate a small sample, apply access rules, keep tokens server-side, and preserve stable IDs/history. Document rollback/export. Stay file-backed until persistence needs justify migration.

Name: Expand reliable nationwide discovery
Completion criteria: Improve free-first state rotation, source coverage, log-home evidence, and deduplication. Review a small new batch across several states; measure candidate quality and requests. Do not introduce paid API usage by default.

Name: Keep older cabins and automate on-demand status checks
Completion criteria: Retain aging records; build a reusable check-and-apply command with evidence and change history. Label confirmed sold/pending/off-market states; preserve uncertain checks. Replace age-only expiry with honest status labels and correct for-sale counts/SEO when implemented. See listing-lifecycle.md.
Evidence/PR: docs/listing-status.md; preview/apply command, source/status tests and retained-card browser checks; pending manual deployment

Name: Automate preparation and maintain a seven-post ready buffer
Completion criteria: Build on existing tools: repeatable discovery/check/selection/caption/cover preparation, resumable queue, exception report and seven distinct ready posts. Preserve current four-slide/caption format. Manual/source uncertainty review where needed; no posting merely from preparation.

Name: Track operational health and recover publication failures
Completion criteria: Generate a low-cost report of source failures, token/permission health, queue depth, receipts, status/photo checks and deployment drift. Preserve idempotency, backups, bounded retries and a kill switch before enabling scheduled jobs.

Name: Schedule prepared Instagram posts after readiness checks
Completion criteria: Follow automation stages A–I: solve supported source-check runner access, choose cadence/timezone/start/queue explicitly, then enable bounded scheduling with freshness checks, receipts, duplicate prevention, pause rules and a kill switch. No unattended schedule enabled by this plan.

Name: Measure useful growth
Completion criteria: Choose low-cost analytics; track Instagram-to-site visits, original-listing clicks, saves, and state interest. Use tagged profile links; establish a baseline before claiming improvements.

Name: Expand useful SEO content
Completion criteria: Add state/location pages only where inventory supports them, strengthen listing metadata/internal links, and verify search indexing on the permanent domain. Avoid thin mass-generated pages.

Name: Test log-home editorial themes and light audience growth
Completion criteria: Use the reference review without copying Cheap Old Houses: test affordable/wooded/waterfront/mountain themes, keep source links, measure outcomes and consider a quiet opt-in digest or submitted cabins later. No subscription-heavy homepage, invented success stories or unauthorized outreach.

Name: Run a weekly project and backlog review
Completion criteria: Review inventory, published content, failures, spend, and results; select the next item; update statuses and evidence; maintain this repository backlog. Consider alerts, email digests, or advanced filters only after core usage supports them.
